# velora-deb-installer

Package Installer helps users install and remove local packages.

- Repository: <https://github.com/LingmoOS/velora-deb-installer>
- License: `GPL-3.0-or-later`
- One-line summary source: `debian/control` (`Description` of `Package: deepin-deb-installer`)

## Layout

| Path | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `.github/workflows/` | CI workflows (1 file) |
| `LICENSES/` | 8 files |
| `assets/` | assets (3 subdirectories, 6 files) |
| `cmake/` | CMake modules and find scripts (1 file) |

## Build

The top-level build script is `CMakeLists.txt` at the repository root (`cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)`, `project(deepin_deb_installer)`).

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
```

The top-level script has no `install()` rule, so build artifacts stay in `build/`.

## Dependencies

`Build-Depends` in `debian/control` lists 15 entries; the first 8 are listed below (see `debian/control` for the complete list):

- `debhelper (>= 9)`
- `pkg-config`
- `cmake`
- `qt6-5compat-dev`
- `qt6-base-dev`
- `qt6-tools-dev-tools`
- `qt6-tools-dev`
- `qt6-svg-dev`

The top-level `CMakeLists.txt` looks up 2 packages with `find_package`: `QT`, `QApt`.

## Translations

Translation files are in `translations/`, 49 `.ts` files in total.

- `deepin-deb-installer_<locale>.ts` form: 48 files (e.g. `deepin-deb-installer_am_ET.ts`).
- files without a language suffix: 1 (`deepin-deb-installer.ts`).
- subdirectories: `desktop`, `policy`.
- sample file names: `deepin-deb-installer.ts`, `deepin-deb-installer_am_ET.ts`, `deepin-deb-installer_ar.ts`, `deepin-deb-installer_ast.ts`, `deepin-deb-installer_az.ts`, `deepin-deb-installer_bg.ts`.

## Packaging

The `debian/` directory provides the Debian packaging files (`control`, `changelog`, `rules`, `copyright`, `source/format`, `compat`).

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Source package | `velora-deb-installer` |
| Binary packages | `deepin-deb-installer` |
| Version | `6.5.33.lingmo.1` (`debian/changelog`) |
| Section | `utils` |
| Homepage | https://github.com/LingmoOS/velora-deb-installer |

```bash
sudo apt build-dep .
dpkg-buildpackage -uc -us -nc -b
```
